name: Circuitry.ai
description: Circuitry.ai connects Claude to your organization's AI Advisors — service, warranty, and product experts grounded in your own knowledge base. Ask a configured Advisor (e.g. Auto Warranty, HVAC, Lawn Mowers, Medical Device) a natural-language question and get a sourced, tenant-grounded answer, or discover which Advisors your organization has configured. Every response is scoped to your authenticated Circuitry organization — you only ever see your own tenant's data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Circuitry.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Circuitry.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.circuitry.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Circuitry.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Circuitry.ai provides these MCP tools: ask_auto_warranty_advisor, ask_hvac_advisor, ask_lawn_mower_advisor, ask_medical_device_advisor, and list_advisors.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Circuitry.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Circuitry.ai in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Circuitry.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Circuitry.ai is developed by Circuitry.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
